dct_description_sm: "Copyrighted 1895 by Rooney & Schleis." "E.P. Knoll & Co., Map Publishers, 8 North Sixth St., Phila., Pa." "Entered according to act of Congress in the year 1890 by Brice and Smith in the office of Librarian of Congress."
